# AdapterRunResult

`schemas/adapter/run-result.json`

run's result, after its notifications: the result triple, the produced result (null whenever the outcome is could_not_run or failed) and the final usage report.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | yes | [Outcome](common-defs.md#outcome) |  |
| `reason` | yes | [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) |  |
| `detail` | yes | string (maxLength `4096`) |  |
| `result` | yes | null or object ([fields](#fields-of-result)) |  |
| `usage_final` | yes | null or object ([fields](#fields-of-usage_final)) | The call's final usage as the adapter reports it, or null when the adapter cannot know it (describe().telemetry.usage false, an interrupted run). Never invented. Null creates no final measurement: the controller keeps the call recorded with its best available liability estimate (the sum of its usage deltas, held uncertain, or its reservation when there are none) until a provider reconciliation resolves it (05; internal/capacity/ledger). The controller builds the measurement. |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (2, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `outcome` one of `could_not_run`, `failed`, then `result` `null`
- when `outcome` one of `found`, `could_not_run`, `failed`, then `detail` any (minLength `1`)
